# crewmate

> crewmate watches GitHub PR comments and issues for `@crewmate` mentions, then emits events or replies with explanations and generated fixes.

Important notes:

- End users install the published CLI with `npm install -g crewmate`.
- Development requires Node.js 24+ and [Nub](https://nubjs.com).
- `crewmate watch` invokes a configurable LLM provider and posts replies; `crewmate stream` emits NDJSON without invoking a provider or posting.
